## Bug fixes

- Valid links to repository directories now pass documentation checks when they end with a slash.
- Newly added files now receive consistent changed-line coverage before and after staging.
- Startup can resume an existing session after the machine's display name changes, while preserving
  its original owner and runtime binding.

Qualified through the normal local compiled-package release process. Repository installations
remain pinned until deliberately updated. No live provider, device or development-cost benefit is
claimed by this release.
